summary: Square's Musashi action-RPG line, pairing the original PlayStation Brave Fencer Musashi with the PlayStation 2 follow-up Musashi: Samurai Legend.

entries.title: Brave Fencer Musashi

emulation.notes: Use internal resolution scaling and conservative enhancements for the original PS1 version.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation assets with high-quality PS1 emulation and modern capture.

primary.why: The original PlayStation release remains the complete baseline version; the Japanese PSN release is an older digital route, and the mobile adaptation is simplified rather than definitive.
primary.how_to_play: Play an owned PlayStation disc or image through DuckStation with internal resolution scaling. Use the Japanese PSN release only where accessible.

all_releases.reason: primary: complete source release and best archival route with high-quality PS1 emulation.

all_releases.fidelity: Japanese PlayStation re-release bundle with merchandise.
all_releases.reason: skip: collectible re-release, not a different gameplay version.

all_releases.fidelity: Simplified Japan-exclusive mobile adaptation titled Musashi: Mobile Samurai.
all_releases.reason: skip: adaptation, not the complete original game.
skip: official digital route, but region-limited and not a modern enhanced remaster.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The mobile adaptation is lower-completeness; the PlayStation original remains the full game.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced modern remaster or remake; Musashi: Samurai Legend is a separate sequel/follow-up entry.

entries.title: Musashi: Samurai Legend

emulation.notes: Use PCSX2 internal resolution scaling for the best capture route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PS2 presentation with high-resolution emulation.

primary.why: Musashi: Samurai Legend was released for PlayStation 2 and has no sourced modern remaster or port; the original PS2 version is the complete version, with PCSX2 offering the best fidelity/capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS2 hardware or through PCSX2 with an owned disc image, using internal resolution scaling for clean capture.

all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release and best archival route with high-quality PS2 emulation.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced alternate release or exclusive-content split.

entries.remaster_caveats: No sourced modern remaster or re-release.
